Medical Virtual Assistant: Refills, Scheduling, and Authorizations

Remote | Endocrinology | Part-Time | 30 Hours/Week | $5/Hour

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Medical Virtual Assistant to support a growing medical practice with prior authorizations, prescription refill coordination, patient scheduling, telephone encounters, and basic claims follow-up.

This role will work closely with the clinic's existing virtual assistant, front-desk staff, providers, and office manager to ensure patient requests are addressed promptly and administrative tasks are completed accurately.

The ideal candidate has experience working in a U.S. medical practice, understands how to manage patient messages and insurance-related tasks, and can confidently prioritize multiple responsibilities without allowing requests to remain unresolved.

This is a blended front-desk and back-office support position. It is not a full medical billing or coding role.

Key Responsibilities

Prior Authorizations

  • Gather required patient, insurance, and clinical information for authorization requests.

  • Submit prior authorizations through payer portals, phone, fax, or other approved methods.

  • Track pending requests, follow up with insurance companies, and escalate delays or denials.

Prescription Refill Coordination

  • Review refill requests received through calls, messages, and telephone encounters.

  • Confirm required information and route requests to the appropriate provider for approval.

  • Follow up on pending requests and communicate status updates to patients.

Appointment Scheduling and Patient Calls

  • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments for new and existing patients.

  • Answer and return calls related to appointments, refills, referrals, and authorizations.

  • Contact patients for follow-up, missing information, or appointment coordination.

Message and Telephone Encounter Management

  • Review voicemail, AI-generated messages, and assigned telephone encounters in eClinicalWorks.

  • Respond to routine requests or route them to the appropriate clinic team member.

  • Monitor open messages to ensure they are completed, documented, or escalated promptly.

Claims and Appeals Support

  • Review assigned returned, rejected, or pending claims.

  • Submit requested medical records, corrected information, or supporting documentation.

  • Assist with straightforward claim resubmissions, basic appeals, and payer follow-up.

Documentation and Escalation

  • Document patient, provider, and insurance communication accurately in the appropriate system.

  • Maintain clear notes regarding completed tasks, pending actions, and follow-up dates.

  • Escalate urgent, clinical, or complex concerns to the provider or office manager.

Team and Administrative Support

  • Work closely with the existing virtual assistant, providers, and onsite clinic staff.

  • Provide updates on assigned, pending, and completed responsibilities.

  • Support additional administrative tasks as clinic workflows and operational needs evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • At least one year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Patient Coordinator, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Experience working with a U.S.-based medical practice.

  • Experience processing or supporting prior authorizations.

  • Experience coordinating prescription refill requests.

  • Experience scheduling patients and handling inbound and outbound calls.

  • Familiarity with electronic health records and telephone encounters.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to document information clearly and accurately.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple queues, messages, and follow-up tasks.

  • Ability to recognize when a concern should be escalated.

  • High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

  • Reliable internet connection and a secure home-based work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using eClinicalWorks.

  • Experience with claims follow-up, medical-record submissions, corrected claims, or basic appeals.

  • Experience working with AI-assisted phone or patient messaging systems.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and patient privacy standards.

  • Experience supporting a growing or high-volume medical practice.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining regular communication with the team.

Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Serves as lead responsible for monitoring, maintaining and coordinating work assignments. Performs ongoing audits of select inpatients and outpatient accounts and provides training to ensure optimum reimbursement and hospital coding compliance. Ensures accurate and appropriate information is documented, coded, and entered into the system(s) in order to meet departmental, hospital and outside agency requirements. This includes appropriate reimbursement, verification, compliance, and charging with the various coding guidelines and regulatory agencies. Responsible for obtaining accurate and complete documentation in the medical record for accurate coding assignment, severity of illness and risk of mortality for each medical record.

The Boeing Company is currently seeking a Chief Software Engineer (Virtual) to support our Vehicle Management Software Team. This position will support the Boeing Defense Services (BDS) business organization.

We are seeking a Chief Software Engineer passionate about space and eager to work in a multi-disciplined, collaborative environment supporting the design, development, and deployment of vehicle management software for Boeing commercial and government space programs. This role requires proven experience across the software ecosystem—directing implementation, integration, verification/validation, and maintenance of complex systems while advising cross-functional teams on requirements, architecture, and test strategies. The successful candidate will demonstrate superior judgment, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills, influence adoption of emerging technologies, and mentor engineering peers to sustain and advance mission-critical capabilities.

In this role, the individual will direct the implementation, deployment, and maintenance of vehicle management software, ensuring compliance with internal and industry standards, processes, and regulations. The CSE will provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams—shaping system-level design and architecture, guiding verification/validation and integration, and advising stakeholders on requirements, test plans, and issue resolution. raw.excerpt: SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs.
raw.description:
SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. We are a collection of executives, engineers, data scientists, and visionaries from NFL clubs, technology startups, finance, and academia.

Our data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.

What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

We’re hiring a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer to build and improve sports video intelligence models—detection, tracking, pose, event understanding, and multi-view reasoning. You’ll spend most of your time on CV research + applied modeling (experiments, architectures, training, evaluation), and partner with data/platform teammates to ensure your work can ship reliably.

This role is CV-first. A bend toward scalable pipelines / MLOps is a plus, not a requirement. Level (mid vs senior) depends on scope ownership and how independently you can drive results.

Responsibilities

CV Modeling & Experimentation

  • Build and train CV models for sports video: player/ball detection, multi-object tracking, pose/keypoints, event/action recognition, identity association (re-ID).
  • Own the experimentation loop: hypotheses → ablations → error analysis → measurable improvements.
  • Design and maintain evaluation: task-appropriate metrics (e.g., MOT metrics, keypoint accuracy, event precision/recall), dataset slices, and failure taxonomy.
  • Improve data efficiency: augmentations, sampling strategies, handling label noise, weak/self-supervision where helpful.
  • Prototype and iterate on modern architectures (e.g., transformer-based detection/tracking, temporal models, multi-task setups).

Research that Ships

  • Collaborate on dataset + labeling design: formats, schemas, tooling, versioning.
  • Help productionize models: packaging, batch/stream inference patterns, throughput/latency tradeoffs, robustness checks.
  • Add lightweight quality gates: reproducibility, automated eval, regression detection

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Strong applied CV experience with hands-on model development (not just running existing repos).
  • Solid PyTorch skills: training loops, debugging, data pipelines for vision workloads, DDP basics.
  • Comfort with video CV fundamentals: occlusion, identity switches, temporal consistency, calibration, domain shift.
  • Strong Python engineering and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Nice-to-have (Bonus):

  • Sports video CV or adjacent domains (multi-agent tracking, pose, crowded scenes).
  • Experience with video tooling (FFmpeg), efficient dataset formats (WebDataset/shards), or streaming/batching to GPUs.
  • MLOps/production experience: model packaging, CI for training/eval, serving (Triton/TorchServe), monitoring.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Bonus Plan
  • Comprehensive health insurance plan
  • Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match
  • Remote working environment
  • A flexible, unlimited time off policy
  • Generous paid holiday schedule - 13 in total including Monday after the Super Bowl

SumerSports is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Job Title: Associate Clinical Quality Operations Manager, Oncology III

Job Location: Lima, Peru

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description

The Associate Clinical Quality Operations Manager (ACQOM) plays a key role in ensuring our company receivesconsistent, accurate, and high-quality clinical trial data worldwide. Working closely with the Clinical Quality Operations Lead (CQOL) and Head of CQO, the ACQOM supports operational quality management, risk management, inspection readiness, supplier oversight, and continuous quality improvement within assigned therapeutic areas.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Trial Quality Support

  • Support Clinical Trial Teams embedding Quality by Design (QbD) principles throughout clinical development programs.

  • Conduct quality control activities to identify emerging study risks, process gaps, and quality issues.

  • Review quality documentation and trial quality folders for completeness and accuracy.

  • Assist with mergers, acquisitions, and integration activities to ensure knowledge transfer, risk mitigation, and inspection readiness.

Risk Management

  • Develop expertise in risk management tools and processes

  • Review critical data and processes throughout the clinical trial lifecycle to ensure risks are identified, monitored, and mitigated.

Regulatory Inspection Readiness

  • Support sponsor and investigator-site inspections and help maintain ongoing inspection readiness.

  • Participate in Inspection Support Teams (ISTs).

  • Manage and track Corrective and Preventive Actionsand regulatory commitments through completion.

  • Perform quality reviews of inspection documentation repositories and support inspection response development.

  • Analyze inspection outcomes for trends and lessons learned.

Quality Assurance Audits

  • Assist with audit preparation, facilitation, root cause analysis, response development, and CAPA management.

  • Provide project management support for audit-related activities and CAPA implementation.

Third-Party Supplier Oversight

  • Support oversight of clinical research vendors and suppliers to ensure compliance and quality performance.

  • Assist with quality agreements, audits, inspections, performance monitoring, issue resolution, risk management, and CAPA development.

CQO Infrastructure and Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to process innovation and improvement initiatives.

  • Develop advanced knowledge of global Good Clinical Practice (GCP) requirements, including ICH, FDA regulations, and EMA Clinical Trial Regulations.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant healthcare, life sciences, or related field.

  • Additional formal education or certification in Quality Management or Business Management is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and/or clinical research.

  • Knowledge of quality management and risk management methodologies is desirable.

  • Understanding of clinical development programs and clinical trial processes.

  • Experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS).

  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and global regulatory health authority requirements.

  • Prior experience conducting root cause analysis and managing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs).

Key Skills & Competencies

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a global environment.

  • Strong teamwork and leadership abilities.

  • Skilled in conflict resolution and handling sensitive matters with discretion.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.

Leadership & Project Management

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams within and outside the organization.

  • Capable of driving initiatives and achieving results through collaboration and influence.

Analytical & Strategic Thinking

  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and resolve complex issues.

  • Strong strategic thinking, creativity, and innovation skills.

  • Ability to identify trends, risks, and key findings from audits and inspections.

Inspection & Compliance Management

  • Ability to act with urgency and effectiveness during global regulatory inspections.

  • Skilled in summarizing audit and inspection findings and translating them into actionable lessons learned.

  • Experience supporting compliance, quality oversight, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills:

Adaptability, Adaptability, Clinical Development, Clinical Research, Clinical Trial Development, Clinical Trials, Clinical Trials Monitoring, Clinical Trials Operations, Conflict Resolution, Data Analysis, Dedication to Patient Care, Ethical Standards, FDA Regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH GCP Guidelines, Inspection Readiness, Leadership Mentoring, Life Science, Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), Project Leadership, Quality Assurance Processes, Quality Management, Quality Process Development, Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Submissions {+ 1 more}

raw.description:
SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. We are a collection of executives, engineers, data scientists, and visionaries from NFL clubs, technology startups, finance, and academia.

Our data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.

What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

Position Summary

The Senior Data Scientist will be focused on model evaluation and quality for our football ML models. You'll

contribute to the work that sits between research and production, making sure the models we ship measure what we think they measure. We believe good research is less about having the perfect idea and more about building a rigorous

system for testing ideas. Ideas are plentiful. The real work is designing experiments, learning quickly,

and following the evidence.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to model evaluation across our football models. Drive one or two threads end-to-end.
  • Build and extend the tooling we use to test, compare, and ship models.
  • Work with football subject-matter experts to design evaluation that reflects how the models will actually get used.
  • Catch silent regressions before they ship.
  • Pushback when a stakeholder asks for a metric that doesn't measure what they think.
  • Build the experimentation harness that lets the team test many ideas fast.

Qualifications

  • Strong statistical foundations. Calibration (reliability and resolution), bootstrapping, inter-rater reliability.
  • Track record contributing to model evaluation on a production ML team.
  • Production ML pipeline experience. You've seen schema drift, label noise, and leakage.
  • You build tooling, not just consume it.
  • Self-starter. Takes strategic direction and shapes their own path.
  • AI-native. Builds skills, loops, and tooling to accelerate evaluation throughput.
  • Stays current with research. Papers, releases, new techniques.
  • Domain absorption capacity. You've gotten fluent on a complex domain (sports, finance, biotech, medical) on a prior job

Bonus Points

  • Football or sports analytics exposure.Experience evaluating tracking-data models.
  • Skill scores for probabilistic forecasts (Brier, etc.).
  • Deep-learning fluency to read training code.
  • Human-in-the-loop ML experience.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Bonus Plan
  • Comprehensive health insurance plan
  • Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match
  • Remote working environment
  • A flexible, unlimited time off policy
  • Generous paid holiday schedule - 13 in total including Monday after the Super Bowl

SumerSports is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Job Description:

Job Title: Director, Payer Access Cell Therapy (PACT)

Reports to: VP US Head of Market Access

Department: Commercial

Hours: Full Time

Location: U.S., Remote

About Autolus

Autolus is a biopharmaceutical company, advancing innovative therapies at both clinical and commercial stages of development, focused on next-generation, programmed T cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. Using a broad suite of proprietary and modular T cell programming technologies, the company is engineering precisely targeted, controlled, and highly active T cell therapies designed to better recognize cancer cells, break down their defence mechanisms, and eliminate these cells. Autolus has a pipeline of product candidates in development for the treatment of haematological malignancies, solid tumours, and autoimmune diseases.

Why Autolus

Our team is passionate in the pursuit of excellence and in pushing the boundaries of cancer therapy to deliver life-changing treatments to patients. Whilst working at Autolus you will enjoy a flexible, diverse, and dynamic working environment which actively promotes creativity, leadership and teamwork. In addition to this Autolus is proud to offer a competitive salary, performance related bonus as well as private medical insurance, life assurance, pension and access to an employee share scheme. Autolus promotes flexible working.

Our Promise

Autolus is developing complex, breakthrough therapies for a globally diverse market and equally recognises that diversity amongst our people is critical to our mission. As we draw on our differences, what we’ve experienced, and how we work, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

Role Summary

This role will be covering the Central/North East area. The Director, Payer Access Cell Therapy will be an integral member of the commercial organization, focused on operationalizing the overall Market Access strategy, and ensuring patients have timely access to Autolus therapies. The primary objective of the Director, Payer Access Cell Therapy is to secure robust coverage and reimbursement for all Autolus products through regional, national, and government payers. In collaboration with center engagement and account management, this role will be integral to onboarding treatment centers and supporting broad timely patient access. The Director, Payer Access Cell Therapy will be a thought leader on all access related items including payer policy, pricing communication, and treatment center reimbursement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and manage strategic relationships with National / Regional Commercial and Government payers within assigned geography.
  • Implement approved pre-launch payer education plan to ensure awareness of Autolus pipeline and prepare the payer market for new cell therapy entrants.
  • Present / provide approved product education and health economic information to key customers and communicate the value proposition of Autolus products.
  • Assess payer and policy landscape to understand and plan for potential coverage of Autolus products for Commercial, Medicare and Medicaid patients, including policy legislation, payer class management, and advocacy.
  • Obtain coverage for Autolus products within assigned accounts, while also identifying and mitigating potential challenges that may hinder access.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs and Global Market Access team to address clinical and outcomes concerns from payers.
  • Working knowledge of total cost of care and all aspects of reimbursement (coding, coverage, and payment) for inpatient and outpatient settings across payer segments.
  • Understand payer requirements and hospital reimbursement for cell therapies administered in the inpatient setting, including CMS requirements and implications for new novel therapies.
  • Inform and educate authorized treatment centers on coverage, billing, coding, and reimbursement of Autolus cell therapies.
  • Work with Autolus Patient Support to ensure understanding of payer coverage policies and requirements and assist with any coverage questions.
  • Responsible and accountable for the successful implementation within geography of the strategic and tactical market access plan.
  • Post launch, partner with field account management team to provide education on respective payers and to address any questions or concerns that arise.

Demonstrated Skills and Competencies

Experience

  • Demonstrated successful experience with National and Regional payers in Commercial, Medicaid, and Medicare.
  • Sustained track record of access and reimbursement achievement in cell therapy, gene therapy, or hematology / oncology.
  • Excellent strategic and business acumen skills, with demonstrated ability to successfully partner with payers.
  • Knowledge of medical benefit along with inpatient and outpatient economics preferred.
  • Extensive experience with private and public payers, across all settings of care, to include the economic complexities for reimbursement in each setting.
  • Extensive understanding of hematology / oncology clinical landscape, and the business of cell therapy.
  • Strong ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally to ensure goals are achieved.
  • Possess a willingness and ability to work hands-on and with a sense of urgency, in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Experience in onboarding cell therapies with treatment centers highly preferred.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher and 10+ years hematology / oncology experience in payer relations and market access.

Skills/Specialist Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of CART/Cell Therapy access, reimbursement, and policy dynamics.
  • In-depth therapeutic and clinical knowledge in hematologic malignancies.
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic, fast paced environment.
  • Routinely synthesizes customer information into actionable insights & recommendations.
  • Proven leadership experience and capabilities.
  • Recognized role model of Autolus core values and ways of working that inspire high performance culture and engagement.
  • Ability to problem solve, demonstrate flexibility, and think strategically.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively present to and engage with a wide range of audiences.
  • Proficient in PowerPoint, excel and word.
  • Resilient in high-pressure environments.

Travel Required: Approximately 50%

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $194,000 - $260,000

Actual compensation will be determined based on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity considerations.

Resilience: Has the capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness

Das Portfolio von GSK umfasst drei Produktbereiche: Impfstoffe, Spezialmedikamente und Allgemeinmedizin. Unser Ziel ist es, für Patienten weltweit bessere und schnellere Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Unser konkurrenzloses Impfstoffportfolio zielt auf Infektionskrankheiten in jeder Lebensphase ab und trägt dazu bei, die Krankheitslast für Hunderte von Millionen Menschen zu verringern. GSK verfügt über außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten in der Impfstoffwissenschaft und -technologie, einschließlich Adjuvans/Proteine und mRNA. Im Bereich der Spezialmedikamente sind wir führend bei der HIV-Prävention und -Behandlung, und wir bauen unsere Präsenz in wichtigen Therapiegebieten wie Onkologie und Autoimmunkrankheiten aus. Zu den allgemeinen Arzneimitteln gehören unsere inhalativen Medikamente gegen Asthma und COPD, Antibiotika und Medikamente gegen Hautkrankheiten.

Bis 2031 streben wir einen Jahresumsatz von 31 bis 33 Milliarden Pfund an - ein Leistungs- und Wachstumssprung, der den positiven Einfluss, den wir auf die Gesundheit von Milliarden von Patienten in aller Welt haben können, deutlich erhöhen wird. Und wir sind zuversichtlich für unsere Zukunft. Wir verfügen jetzt über eine Pipeline von 69 Impfstoffen und Spezialarzneimitteln, von denen viele das Potenzial haben, die ersten oder besten ihrer Art zu sein.

Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.

Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!

At Credit Acceptance, cloud computing continues to allow us to modernize and consolidate IT infrastructure, automate workloads, and pursue next-generation innovation. To continue this transformation, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Staff Cloud Engineer with expertise in the strategy, design, development, and implementation of large-scale projects in the cloud. The ideal candidate is experienced in cloud-based tech, with a firm grasp of emerging technologies, platforms, and applications, and ability to customize them to help our business become more secure and efficient. Extensive knowledge of cloud maintenance and advanced industry knowledge is key to keeping us on the cutting edge.

From day one, you’ll have an immediate impact on the day-to-day efficiency of our IT infrastructure and an ongoing impact on our overall growth. The Senior Staff Cloud Engineer owns the cloud and is responsible for architecture, administration, maintenance and availability of all cloud infrastructure and supporting tools. Additionally, Senior Staff Cloud Engineer demonstrates and encourages a culture of automation, orchestration and efficiency. The position is key to driving cloud strategy that is consistent with the department and business goals.

Outcomes and Activities:

  • This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position ispermittedto work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member
  • Provide thought leadership and build cloud solutions that deliver high impact business value and deliver customer delight
  • Lead the design and implementation of cloud solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable
  • Collaborate with a diverse cross functional team including business partners, Product Managers and designers to define product requirements, direction and clarity
  • Drive technical innovation and improvements of the design and architecture of cloud systems towards leading edge technologies and practices at the organization level
  • Define, develop and drive cloud engineering best practices
  • Become an expert in the business process domain to better support the business and align technologies with the business outcomes
  • Develops cross-disciplinary knowledge and an understanding of the market context to drive organization-level solutions

  • Conduct impact analysis to proactively identify impact of a change across multiple applications/systems

  • Develop standard architectural practices and lead solutions development across partner engineering groups

  • Ensure application performance, uptime, and scale, maintaining high standards of quality and thoughtful design
  • Conduct routine environment audits of cloud accounts for compliance with established standards, policies, configuration guidelines and procedures
  • Maintain a comprehensive cloud library of all supporting documentation

Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role.

  • Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
  • Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
  • One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
  • Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience designing scalable Cloud/Hybrid environments with a strong background in AWS and Azure
  • Experience developing and managing Infrastructure as Code, leveraging tools such as Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, etc.
  • Experience in the lead role overseeing technical direction for multiple Cloud/Platform/Development/DevOps/SRE teams
  • Extensive experience with building and driving adoption of Cloud engineering best practices
  • Experience driving impact on mission-critical enterprise class applications having organization-wide impact
  • Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns and at least one LLM gateway or proxy product (LiteLLM, Portkey, AWS Bedrock Gateway, or equivalent), including model routing, rate limiting, and token usage attribution in a multi-tenant cloud environment

Preferred:

  • Experience in a hybrid Cloud/Data Center environment supporting various multi-tier and microservice applications
  • Experience with SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS deployments in the Cloud
  • Experience developing and maintaining performance metrics and graphs
  • Experience with other clouds like Oracle and Google
  • Experience with backup and data protection technologies
  • Experience with patching tools
  • Experience with virtualization environments
  • Experience with observability and alerting tools like PagerDuty
  • Ability to use Excel or similar tool(s) to provide value from various data sources
  • Experience working with monitoring/trending software such as CloudWatch, ELK, Splunk, etc
  • Expert knowledge of DevOps processes
  • Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, and familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for building or securing agent tool interfaces
  • Experience with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Cedar, or equivalent) in production cloud environments, particularly for access control and automated compliance enforcement

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of cloud best practices with experience building complex software engineering products
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud computing, and microservices architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to coach business partners, cross functional team members, and mentor senior-level members
  • Proven track record driving continuous improvements with cloud technology
  • Proven ability to drive automation and build self service capabilities for Software Engineers
  • Development of automation scripts in various automation, orchestration, scripting, or programming languages
  • Ability to right-size cloud infrastructure with cost, and performance in mind

Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $161,000 – $237,000. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 15-30%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. Our data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.

What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

We’re hiring a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer to build and improve sports video intelligence models—detection, tracking, pose, event understanding, and multi-view reasoning. You’ll spend most of your time on CV research + applied modeling (experiments, architectures, training, evaluation), and partner with data/platform teammates to ensure your work can ship reliably.

This role is CV-first. A bend toward scalable pipelines / MLOps is a plus, not a requirement. Level (mid vs senior) depends on scope ownership and how independently you can drive results.

Responsibilities

CV Modeling & Experimentation

  • Build and train CV models for sports video: player/ball detection, multi-object tracking, pose/keypoints, event/action recognition, identity association (re-ID).
  • Own the experimentation loop: hypotheses → ablations → error analysis → measurable improvements.
  • Design and maintain evaluation: task-appropriate metrics (e.g., MOT metrics, keypoint accuracy, event precision/recall), dataset slices, and failure taxonomy.
  • Improve data efficiency: augmentations, sampling strategies, handling label noise, weak/self-supervision where helpful.
  • Prototype and iterate on modern architectures (e.g., transformer-based detection/tracking, temporal models, multi-task setups).

Research that Ships

  • Collaborate on dataset + labeling design: formats, schemas, tooling, versioning.
  • Help productionize models: packaging, batch/stream inference patterns, throughput/latency tradeoffs, robustness checks.
  • Add lightweight quality gates: reproducibility, automated eval, regression detection

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Strong applied CV experience with hands-on model development (not just running existing repos).
  • Solid PyTorch skills: training loops, debugging, data pipelines for vision workloads, DDP basics.
  • Comfort with video CV fundamentals: occlusion, identity switches, temporal consistency, calibration, domain shift.
  • Strong Python engineering and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Nice-to-have (Bonus):

  • Sports video CV or adjacent domains (multi-agent tracking, pose, crowded scenes).
  • Experience with video tooling (FFmpeg), efficient dataset formats (WebDataset/shards), or streaming/batching to GPUs.
  • MLOps/production experience: model packaging, CI for training/eval, serving (Triton/TorchServe), monitoring.

Das Portfolio von GSK umfasst drei Produktbereiche: Impfstoffe, Spezialmedikamente und Allgemeinmedizin. Unser Ziel ist es, für Patienten weltweit bessere und schnellere Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Unser konkurrenzloses Impfstoffportfolio zielt auf Infektionskrankheiten in jeder Lebensphase ab und trägt dazu bei, die Krankheitslast für Hunderte von Millionen Menschen zu verringern. GSK verfügt über außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten in der Impfstoffwissenschaft und -technologie, einschließlich Adjuvans/Proteine und mRNA. Im Bereich der Spezialmedikamente sind wir führend bei der HIV-Prävention und -Behandlung, und wir bauen unsere Präsenz in wichtigen Therapiegebieten wie Onkologie und Autoimmunkrankheiten aus. Zu den allgemeinen Arzneimitteln gehören unsere inhalativen Medikamente gegen Asthma und COPD, Antibiotika und Medikamente gegen Hautkrankheiten.

Bis 2031 streben wir einen Jahresumsatz von 31 bis 33 Milliarden Pfund an - ein Leistungs- und Wachstumssprung, der den positiven Einfluss, den wir auf die Gesundheit von Milliarden von Patienten in aller Welt haben können, deutlich erhöhen wird. Und wir sind zuversichtlich für unsere Zukunft. Wir verfügen jetzt über eine Pipeline von 69 Impfstoffen und Spezialarzneimitteln, von denen viele das Potenzial haben, die ersten oder besten ihrer Art zu sein.

Key Account Manager*in Onkologie (m/w/d)

Als Key Account Manager*in sind Sie zuständig für Verkauf von und Beratung zu Produkten in der Onkologie innerhalb zugelassener Indikationen und mit Fokus auf Nutzen für Verordner und Patienten.

  • Unterstützung der Vernetzung von Kunden im Sinne integrierter, sektorenübergreifender Versorgung auf Basis sorgfältiger Situationsanalyse und Klärung gemeinsamer Interessen und Motive

At Credit Acceptance, cloud computing continues to allow us to modernize and consolidate IT infrastructure, automate workloads, and pursue next-generation innovation. To continue this transformation, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Staff Cloud Engineer with expertise in the strategy, design, development, and implementation of large-scale projects in the cloud. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.

Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.

As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns and at least one LLM gateway or proxy product (LiteLLM, Portkey, AWS Bedrock Gateway, or equivalent), including model routing, rate limiting, and token usage attribution in a multi-tenant cloud environment

Preferred:

Role Overview

Fluence is seeking a Tools Developer to strengthen its Americas Services organization by designing and developing tools that improve fleet observability, troubleshooting efficiency, proactive monitoring, and operational reliability across Fluence's Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) fleet.

This role sits at the intersection of Software Development, Linux System Administration, Operational Technology (OT), Service Engineering, and Fleet Reliability. The successful candidate will develop software solutions, monitoring frameworks, automation tools, and diagnostic platforms that enable early detection of hardware and software issues, improve root cause analysis, and reduce customer downtime.

The ideal candidate combines strong Python development capabilities with hands-on experience supporting Linux/Ubuntu environments, Distributed Access Systems (DAS), OS7 platforms, Grafana dashboards, operational monitoring systems, and industrial control networks.

This position directly supports customer satisfaction, fleet reliability, service scalability, and operational excellence throughout North and South America.

  • Develop tools that collect, process, analyze, and present operational data from multiple fleet systems and monitoring platforms.
  • Support root cause analysis efforts through development of automated diagnostic workflows and troubleshooting utilities.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

Our attorneys help injured people get back on track. From first call until final resolution, we fight for our clients to get the full compensation they deserve. We investigate the facts and circumstances of the injury, fight for full compensation, and help protect the client’s future.

What You Will Own

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Case Evaluation: Review and assess the merits of clients’ Personal Injury claims by analyzing records, documents, and evidence to determine liability and potential value
  • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients
  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement effective strategies to protect clients’ rights and interests. Conduct legal research, analyze medical records, gather evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies to achieve favorable settlements
  • Client Communication: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing updates, explaining legal processes, and advising them on their rights and options
  • Medical and Vocational Assessment: Collaborate with medical and vocational experts to evaluate the extent of injuries, their impact on clients’ ability to work, and appropriate future treatment requirements
  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

What You Bring

Required:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active admission to the North Carolina Bar
  • 5 - 10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust case load independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of North Carolina laws, regulations, and procedures required
  • Must be located in or near the State of North Carolina
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Active Admission to one or more districts of the North Carolina Federal Court
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Experience in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $115,000 to $150,000 commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

This role is critical to our success because it:

  • Maximizes case value through strong case development, sound evaluation, and effective negotiation prior to litigation
  • Moves cases efficiently through the pre-litigation lifecycle, supporting faster resolutions and improved cash flow
  • Identifies cases that should be escalated to litigation early, enabling better strategy, resource allocation, and outcomes
  • Enhances client satisfaction and trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-through
  • Reduces risk and rework by spotting issues early, making decisive recommendations, and ensuring alignment across teams
  • Supports scale by holding case managers accountable to performance metrics and ensuring consistent, high-quality work product

Welcome to Destination Pet. We are One Pack- a united team working together to elevate the love and lives of pet families. Our pet-obsessed professionals create a connected care network of trustworthy partners who bring creative innovation every day. We are revolutionizing the pet industry. Join us!

The Facilities Support Manager is responsible for supporting the repair, maintenance, and overall facility needs of an assigned portfolio of approximately 40–50 Destination Pet locations. This role serves as a primary point of contact between center operations, vendors, and internal business partners to ensure facility issues are addressed safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

The Facilities Support Manager will typically manage approximately 150–200 active work orders on a continuous basis and must be able to effectively prioritize competing repair, maintenance, project, and emergency needs across multiple locations.

This position requires strong judgment, organization, communication, technical curiosity, financial awareness, and the ability to independently drive facility issues from initial identification through resolution.

We are looking to add aFacilitiesSupport Managerto our team!

LOCATION: Remote (preferred central or mountain time zones candidate)

REPORTS TO: Vice President of Commercial Excellence

PAY:$70,000 - $85,000/ annually Depending on Experience

CORE RESPONSIBILITES:

Work Order & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the day-to-day facility needs of an assigned portfolio of approximately 40–50 locations and maintain oversight of approximately 150–200 active work orders.

  • Manage repair and maintenance requests submitted through Flow Path (CMMS) from initial submission through completion.

  • Review and prioritize service requests based on scope, urgency, life safety, animal welfare, business continuity, operational impact, and financial exposure.

  • Coordinate troubleshooting, vendor dispatch, estimates, approvals, scheduling, repairs, and follow-up.

  • Provide remote troubleshooting support to non-technical center teams when appropriate toidentify issues, determine next steps, and reduce unnecessary vendor dispatches.

  • Proactively manage aging, delayed, or stalled work orders and maintainaccurate documentation of vendor communications, estimates, photos, approvals, invoices, and completion status.

  • Verify completed work aligns with the approved scope before work orders are closed.

Lease Review & Responsibility Determination

  • Review applicable lease provisions to help determine whether facility repair or maintenance responsibilities are likely theresponsibility of Destination Pet or the landlord.

  • Identify when the appropriate internal resource responsible for landlord communication should be engaged and provide relevant lease language, vendor findings, photos, estimates, and supporting documentation.

  • Escalate unclear or conflicting lease language for further review rather than making assumptions regarding responsibility.

Vendor & Cost Management

  • Source, evaluate, onboard, and coordinate qualified local, regional, and national service providers.

  • Maintain productive vendor relationships while holding providers accountable for responsiveness, pricing, scope, documentation, quality, and completion.

  • Obtain and compare estimates, evaluate proposed repairs, question unclear recommendations, and determine when additionalbids or technical opinions are appropriate.

  • Negotiate pricing, scope, scheduling, and service expectations when appropriate.

  • Review estimates and invoices for accuracy and alignment with approved and completed work.

  • Evaluate repair-versus-replace considerations and identify cost-saving opportunities while balancing reliability, operational needs, and long-term facility requirements.

  • Address incomplete work, repeat service calls, warranty issues, billing discrepancies, and vendor performance concerns.

Project Oversight - R&M & CapEx

  • Support the planning and execution of small- to mid-scale repair, maintenance, and capital projects, including renovations, remodels, HVAC replacements or upgrades, roofing, flooring, plumbing improvements, and other facility upgrades.

  • Develop and clarify scopes of work, obtain and compare vendor bids, coordinate internal approvals, and monitor project schedules, budgets, and vendor deliverables.

  • Review applicable drawings, specifications, architectural or engineering documents, and vendor recommendations at a practicalfacilities-management level, escalating technical questions to the appropriate subject matter experts when needed.

  • Coordinate project execution with center leadership and vendors to minimize operational disruption and verify work is completed in accordance with the approved scope

Emergency Response & Operational Support

  • Assist center leadership with urgent and emergency facility issues affecting life safety, animal welfare, business continuity, or building operations.

  • Coordinate emergency service providers and communicate status, temporary mitigation measures, expected timelines, and next steps.

  • Exercise sound judgment when determining whether immediate vendor response, temporary repair, escalation, or additionaltechnical evaluation is required.

  • Support locations during HVAC failures, plumbing or sewer emergencies, electrical failures, water intrusion, roof leaks, fire/lifesafety concerns, and other critical facility events.

Preventive Maintenance, Inspections & Compliance

  • Support preventive maintenance programs and recurring services for major building systems, including HVAC, plumbing or septic, fire/life-safety systems, pest control, landscaping, and other facility services.

  • Track service schedules and help ensure required maintenance and inspections are completed and appropriately documented.

  • Maintain awareness of health, safety, sanitation, fire/life-safety, and regulatory requirements that may affect pet boarding, daycare, grooming, and veterinary facilities.

  • Partner with field leadership, Safety, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to support timely correction of identifiedfacility, safety, or compliance concerns.

  • Identify recurring equipment failures or facility trends and recommend corrective, replacement, or long-term planning strategies whereappropriate.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Center Support

  • Partner with Center Managers, District Directors, Area Vice Presidents, Finance, Accounts Payable, Real Estate, Legal, Safety, Operations, and other internal stakeholders.

  • Clearly communicate facility conditions, risks, recommendations, estimated costs, timelines, and operational impacts.

  • Provide facility-related guidance and train Center Managers and other field leaders on facilities procedures, basic troubleshooting, equipment awareness, work order expectations, and appropriate escalation.

  • Where applicable, manage and provide day-to-day direction to in-house maintenance technicians assigned within the territory, including prioritizing and assigning work, coordinating schedules and site visits, reviewing completed work and documentation, monitoring workload and performance, and determining when work should be completed in-house versus assigned to an outside vendor.

  • Assist with facility assessments, acquisitions, transitions, renovations, special projects, and other company initiatives as needed.

  • Escalate significant facility risks, recurring failures, major expenditures, or unresolved responsibility questions to Facilities leadership or the appropriate internal resource

REQUIREMENTS:

Education & Experience

Required

• 3+ years of experience in facilities management, property management, construction, maintenance operations, vendor

management, or a related field.

• Experience managing a high-volume, multi-site facilities workload with numerous concurrent repairs, vendors, and competing

priorities.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize urgent issues while maintaining consistent followup across a large active workload.

• Basic understanding of commercial leases and the ability to identify provisions related to repair and maintenance responsibility.

• General working knowledge of common building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, flooring, doors, fencing,

drainage, and fire/life-safety systems.

• Experience reviewing repair proposals, vendor recommendations, estimates, and invoices.

• Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and recognize when escalation or additional expertise is required.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to effectively utilize CMMS, purchasing, and other business systems.

Preferred

• Experience supporting a geographically dispersed, multi-site portfolio.

• Experience in pet care, veterinary, hospitality, retail, healthcare, property management, or another operationally intensive

environment.

• Experience reviewing commercial lease provisions, vendor contracts, service agreements, or capital project documentation.

• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, capital expenditure planning, and emergency facility response.

Experience providing day-to-day direction or supervision to maintenance technicians, field service personnel, or similar

employees.

• Working knowledge of construction terminology, building systems, and basic code or life-safety requirements.

Key Competencies

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for issues through resolution and maintains consistent follow-up.

  • Prioritization & Judgment: Effectively manages a high-volume workload and recognizes when issues require immediate action, additional evaluation, or escalation.

  • Problem Solving: Investigates root causes, asks appropriate technical questions, and challenges recommendations when necessary.

  • Financial & Vendor Management: Balances cost, operational need, long-term value, and vendor accountability when making repair decisions.

  • Communication & Partnership: Provides clear, timely, and actionable communication to center teams, vendors, and corporate stakeholders

Work Environment & Expectations

  • May coordinate work across multiple states and time zones.

  • Some travel may be required for facility assessments, acquisitions, major projects, training, or other operational needs.

  • The role may periodically require availability outside normal business hours to assist with significant or emergency facilitysituations.

  • Frequent computer and telephone use is required, along with regular interaction with vendors, field leadership, and corporatesupport teams

  • A Startup mentality company with stable funding

  • Pet Care discounts

  • Flexible Time Off

  • Opportunity to grow your career with a network of like-minded professionals

This role will be a key contributor to the SSEG leadership team, driving a portfolio of strategic projects, providing oversight, guidance and risk mitigation, in partnership with SSEG LT members and their teams. The role will drive continued operational excellence through process improvement, strategic planning, resource optimization and management, establishment of supportive systems, and strategic communications.

This role requires an individual who can clarify roles and responsibilities and drive accountability to achieve team success. This is a high-impact role that requires one to lead through influence, successfully navigate a broad, cross-functional and matrixed environment from R&D to commercialization, and manage multiple simultaneous priorities.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Roadmap for the evolution of SSEG functions to ensure the organization remains future-ready. This includes identifying key capabilities and tools and partnering with stakeholder partners to ensure execution.
  • Evaluation of vendor platforms and solutions against key capabilities and financial targets.
  • Strategy, Priorities, Scorecard and KPIs – Work with the LT to develop a department scorecard, identifying the appropriate KPIs for measurement that outline the impact of the organization and progress along the roadmap.
  • Responsible for the efficient utilization of resources across the teams and have a broad view of the vendor landscape and fit for purpose. Manage adaptations and optimizations in internal-external ratio of resources to drive sustainable impact, maintaining SSEG ownership of critical skills while leveraging outsourcing for routine tasks and response to dynamic demand. Work with LT, finance and procurement to support the deployment of SSEG vendor strategy for effectiveness.
  • Annual Planning and Budget Tracking - Lead annual planning cycle efforts across SSEG including annual AOP planning; work closely with Finance and bespoke matrix partners to plan and achieve budget
  • Drive specific strategic projects on an ad-hoc basis, owning dashboards, timelines, and project management

  • Identifysystemic adoption gaps across the customer base and turn them into targeted team initiatives, not one-off fixes

Executive & Strategic Account Engagement

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for the team's most complex, highest-risk, or highest-value accounts

  • Lead adoption and value conversations directly with customer executives when the stakes call for it

  • Represent the health and trajectory of the team's portfolio in internal business reviews

Cross-Functional Influence

  • Partner with Customer Success Engineering, Solution Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Account Management leadership to remove structural blockers to adoption, not just individual account issues

  • Serve as a primary voice of the customer to Product and Engineering leadership, surfacing patterns and platform gaps that affect adoption at scale

  • Own team-level reporting on adoption, consumption, retention, and expansion, and translate that data into a clear narrative for senior leadership

  • Drive renewal and retention outcomes through consistent, provable value delivery across the portfolio

  • A talent developer — you measure your success by what your team becomes, not just what you personally deliver

  • Comfortable moving fluidly between an executive boardroom and a deep technical troubleshooting session

You Have

  • 7+ years of technical experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, post-sales engineering, or cybersecurity consulting

  • Hands-on experience with SaaS security tools or cybersecurity platforms

  • The ability to coach others through complex technical and operational challenges, not just solve them yourself

What We Offer You:

You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. Trend Micro provides benefit options for you and your family. Here some of the top-rated benefits that employees enjoy today:

  • Comprehensive health benefits and paid time off package

  • Pre-partum, maternity, parental, medical leave and adoption assistance

  • Mental Health Wellness Program & Annual Wellness Incentive

We are committed to fostering a professional, respectful, and inclusive work environment that promotes collaboration and high performance. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives and welcome candidates who bring unique strengths and experiences. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can contribute and grow with us, we encourage you to apply.

Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.

Com presença em mercados estratégicos como Portugal, Espanha, Marrocos, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos e China, oferecemos soluções inovadoras em engenharia, TI, design, consultoria, Indústria 4.0, treinamento e recrutamento. Tudo o que fazemos é movido pelo talento de nosso povo.

Este é um momento de crescimento e oportunidade. O futuro pertence a mentes visionárias. Junte-se a nós!

ANALISTA DE GESTÃO DE ACESSOS PLENO

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Gestão de Acessos Pleno para atuar com gestão de usuários, perfis e acessos SAP, apoiando projetos em andamento e demandas relacionadas à administração, análise, validação e execução de acessos.

O profissional será responsável por levantar as necessidades de acesso junto às equipes de projetos, analisar e estruturar as demandas, validar os requisitos junto ao time de Gestão de Acessos e, após as devidas aprovações, realizar as atividades nos ambientes DEV, QAS e PRD.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência prática em SAP GRC Access Control (GRC AC) e SAP IDM, com conhecimento em gestão de usuários, perfis, roles e processos de provisionamento de acessos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar na gestão de usuários, perfis, roles e acessos SAP;
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas à administração e gestão de acessos por meio de SAP GRC AC e SAP IDM;
  • Levantar junto às equipes de projetos as necessidades de usuários, perfis e acessos;
  • Entender e analisar os requisitos de acesso necessários para cada demanda;
  • Estruturar solicitações de criação, alteração, manutenção e revogação de acessos;
  • Atuar na criação e manutenção de usuários, perfis e roles SAP;
  • Validar as necessidades de acesso junto ao time responsável pela Gestão de Acessos;
  • Executar as demandas devidamente aprovadas nos ambientes DEV, QAS e PRD;
  • Apoiar processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de acessos;
  • Realizar testes e validações após a execução das alterações;
  • Acompanhar as demandas desde o levantamento até a conclusão;
  • Identificar e tratar inconsistências relacionadas a usuários, perfis, roles e acessos;
  • Apoiar os projetos na definição e adequação dos acessos necessários;
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas, projetos, áreas de negócio e demais stakeholders;
  • Registrar as atividades e alterações realizadas;
  • Seguir os processos de aprovação, segurança e governança definidos pela empresa.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência profissional com Gestão de Acessos SAP;
  • Experiência com gestão de usuários e perfis SAP;
  • Experiência prática com SAP GRC Access Control (GRC AC);
  • Experiência com SAP IDM (Identity Management);
  • Conhecimento de roles, perfis e autorizações SAP;
  • Vivência com processos de criação, alteração, manutenção e revogação de acessos;
  • Experiência com provisionamento de usuários e acessos;
  • Experiência em ambientes DEV, QAS e PRD;
  • Capacidade de levantar e entender necessidades de acesso junto às equipes de projetos;
  • Conhecimento de processos de aprovação e validação de acessos;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e atento aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas.

Conhecimentos técnicos desejáveis

  • SAP GRC Access Control (GRC AC);
  • SAP IDM – Identity Management;
  • Access Request Management (ARM);
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA);
  • Business Role Management (BRM);
  • Gestão e manutenção de SAP Roles;
  • Provisionamento e desprovisionamento de usuários;
  • Conhecimentos em RBAC (Role-Based Access Control);
  • Conhecimentos em Segregação de Funções (SoD);
  • Conhecimento de Matriz de Acessos;
  • Vivência com processos de auditoria e governança de acessos.

Perfil que buscamos

Profissional Pleno, com experiência prática e hands-on em Gestão de Acessos SAP, especialmente em ambientes que utilizem GRC AC e IDM.

É importante ter autonomia para entender uma demanda de projeto, identificar as necessidades de usuários e perfis, estruturar os requisitos, interagir com as equipes envolvidas e encaminhar a demanda para validação e aprovação.

Após a aprovação, deverá possuir experiência para executar as alterações e configurações necessárias nos ambientes correspondentes, seguindo os processos e procedimentos estabelecidos.

Buscamos um profissional analítico, organizado, comunicativo e orientado à resolução de problemas, com capacidade de atuar em conjunto com equipes técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou evolução de SAP GRC AC e/ou SAP IDM;
  • Experiência com ambientes SAP de grande porte;
  • Vivência com processos de Access Risk Analysis, Access Request Management e Business Role Management;
  • Conhecimento de processos de SoD e análise de riscos de acessos;
  • Experiência com grande volume de usuários, perfis e roles;
  • Vivência em ambientes com processos formais de aprovação, governança e auditoria de acessos;
  • Experiência com integração entre SAP IDM, GRC e demais sistemas corporativos.

Modelo de contratação

PJ | 100% Remoto
