At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

JOB SUMMARY

The Mechanical Integration Engineer is responsible for defining factory level mechanical and thermal solutions that enable the setup, expansion, and optimization of greenfield and brownfield Jabil owned manufacturing facilities in addition to product support. This role leads early phase factory design by scoping, specifying, and integrating mechanical and cooling systems, mimicking data center infrastructure functionality where required, and translating product and process requirements into scalable factory architectures that support efficient facility setup, equipment deployment and long term manufacturing readiness. The position also includes leading test process implementation and equipment selection to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and reliability.

LOCATION

India - Remote

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design of factory level mechanical and cooling architectures, leveraging hyperscale data center design principles to define scalable, resilient infrastructure for Jabil manufacturing facilities
  • Design and integrate air cooled and water cooled chiller plants, dry coolers, heat rejection systems, and associated hydronic distribution networks.
  • Define cooling plant performance requirements including capacity, redundancy (N, N+1, 2N), efficiency, availability, and scalability.
  • Partner with electrical, controls, and operations teams to ensure cooling systems meet availability, resilience, and operational excellence targets.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for single phase and two phase liquid cooling technologies used in hyperscale data centers.
  • Architect and integrate rack level, row level, and facility based liquid cooling systems, including CDUs, manifolds, and heat exchangers.
  • Define operational requirements for LC infrastructure, including pressure ratings, temperature envelopes, flow uniformity, materials compatibility, and long term durability.
  • Ensure seamless thermal and mechanical integration between facility cooling plants and high density IT liquid cooling loops.
  • Review and approve mechanical designs, CAD models, and technical data packages for compliance with system level requirements.
  • Own component selection for piping, valves, fittings, pumps, heat exchangers, and cooling equipment based on fluid type, pressure, temperature, corrosion resistance, and lifecycle cost.
  • Develop and release Bills of Materials (BOMs) and manufacturing documentation for production and deployment.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and best practices (ASME, ISO, applicable building and pressure vessel codes).
  • Perform or oversee thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical analyses, including flow modeling, pressure drop, and stress evaluation.
  • Define and lead system level and component level testing, including leak testing, hydrostatic pressure testing, and performance validation.
  • Evaluate test and field data to confirm conformance to thermo mechanical requirements and drive design improvements.
  • Lead design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) efforts for liquid cooling hardware and assemblies.
  • Optimize manufacturing and installation processes for large scale copper, stainless steel, and aluminum piping systems.
  • Manage technical relationships with cooling equipment OEMs, contract manufacturers, and fabrication partners.
  • Support deployment, commissioning, and early life issue resolution for data center cooling systems
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented
  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight
  • Proficient in reading, analyzing, and interpreting general business publications, professional journals, technical procedures, and government regulations
  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides
  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries
  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices
  • Comfortable working as part of a global team
  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones
  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLCM).
  • Able to mentor less experienced engineers

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree in engineering or higher is preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in mechanical system integration
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • Proven track record of successful system designs and implementations in a relevant industry
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategy, and system coordination
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to Data Center Infrastructure is preferred
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities
  • Alternatively, a suitable combination of education, experience, and/or training may be considered

raw.title: Manager, Engineering
raw.excerpt: Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability.
raw.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

We are seeking a Solutions Architect to own and drive the technical architecture of our Environmental Accounting product area.

This is a hands-on architecture role, ideal for a technically strong engineer who is ready to take ownership of system design, technical direction, and engineering standards while still contributing to the codebase.

You will play a key role in ensuring the engineering teams consistently deliver value to customers through high-quality, reliable, and scalable SaaS solutions. You will also act as the accountable technical authority for the product area within the wider organization, including Product Management, Engineering leadership, and senior stakeholders.

This role requires a strong software engineering background (ideally .NET / C# or Node.js) with the ability to stay close to the code while shaping architecture and influencing across teams. You should be comfortable working in an environment with minimal unnecessary formality, where success is driven through direct communication, trust, and continuous improvement.

Critically, this role demands deep, demonstrable proficiency with AI. We are transforming how we build software and what we build. You will be expected to work fluently within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), to architect and deliver agentic AI solutions within our products, and to bring genuine hands-on experience with agentic coding tools — Claude Code in particular. This is not a theoretical or advisory expectation: we are looking for someone who uses these tools daily, understands their failure modes, and can raise the whole engineering organization's capability with them.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve the technical architecture

  • Define, document, and evolve the target architecture for Sphera's Corporate Sustainability product, covering design, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability
  • Ensure architectural decisions are recorded, justified, and clearly communicated using appropriate modelling and documentation approaches
  • Build a culture of technical excellence, sound design thinking, and continuous improvement across the engineering teams
  • Act as the key technical point of reference for the product area, ensuring alignment with broader engineering and business goals

AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC)

  • Champion and embed an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle across the product area, applying AI meaningfully at every stage — requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support
  • Define what "good" looks like for AI-assisted engineering: prompting and context practices, human review and verification gates, quality bars, and guardrails for what must never be delegated to a model
  • Measure the impact of AI on delivery throughput, defect rates, and engineering experience, and iterate on practices based on evidence rather than hype
  • Establish policy and standards for the safe, secure, and compliant use of AI tooling, including handling of proprietary code, customer data, and intellectual property

Agentic AI solution development

  • Architect and deliver agentic AI capabilities within Sphera's Environmental Accounting product, taking them from prototype through to production
  • Design robust agentic systems: tool and function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls
  • Own the non-functional dimensions of AI features — evaluation and testing strategy, observability, latency, cost management, model selection and versioning, and graceful degradation
  • Address AI-specific risk directly: hallucination and grounding, prompt injection and data exfiltration, access control on agent tooling, auditability, and responsible AI considerations
  • Maintain a working knowledge of the fast-moving AI landscape and make pragmatic build-versus-buy and model-selection recommendations

Hands-on technical leadership

  • Contribute directly to the codebase where it has the greatest impact, using modern software engineering practices
  • Work hands-on with Claude Code and comparable agentic coding tools as a daily part of the role, and set the standard for how the wider team uses them effectively
  • Extend and tailor the team's AI tooling — for example project context files, custom commands, subagents, hooks, and MCP server integrations with internal systems
  • Provide deep technical guidance in .NET / C# or Node.js environments
  • Prototype and validate architectural approaches, spiking on high-risk or high-uncertainty areas ahead of delivery
  • Maintain a strong, current understanding of system design, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and software quality

Delivery and execution

  • Partner closely with Product Management to translate requirements into clear, actionable technical designs and engineering outcomes
  • Ensure architectural work supports consistent, high-quality SaaS releases aligned with business priorities
  • Identify and remove technical blockers, proactively resolving design and integration issues impacting team performance
  • Balance long-term architectural health against near-term delivery needs, making trade-offs explicit

Technical influence and enablement

  • Raise the technical capability of engineers through design reviews, pairing, and mentoring
  • Upskill the team in AI-assisted engineering, coaching engineers to use agentic tooling with judgment — and to critically review what it produces
  • Set and champion engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, and security
  • Have open, honest, and sometimes challenging technical conversations to drive better outcomes
  • Foster a culture of informal, direct communication and trust across the teams

Process and continuous improvement

  • Take ownership of technical practices and evaluate their effectiveness in delivering outcomes
  • Apply critical judgment to existing designs and processes and propose improvements where needed
  • Identify and drive down technical debt, prioritizing work that materially improves reliability and speed of delivery
  • Ensure the teams operate efficiently without unnecessary bureaucracy, while maintaining appropriate engineering discipline

Stakeholder engagement

  • Act as the primary technical voice for the product area to internal stakeholders and customers where required
  • Maintain strong working relationships with Product, Engineering, and wider business functions
  • Ensure transparency in technical direction, risks, and trade-offs

Requirements

Core engineering

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years in an architecture, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity
  • Strong hands-on development experience in .NET / C# or Node.js
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering SaaS or enterprise software products at scale
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), distributed systems, and API design
  • Strong ability to translate product requirements into technical designs and execution
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without direct authority
  • Highly desirable: technical proficiency with Databaricks, Sql Server and Azure SQL

AI proficiency (essential)

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent agentic coding tools, used routinely on real production codebases rather than experimentally
  • Practical experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), applying AI across design, implementation, testing, review, and documentation — and able to speak credibly about where it works, where it does not, and why
  • Solid working understanding of agentic AI design patterns — tool/function calling, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design — with the appetite to take them into production
  • Working knowledge of the current LLM landscape and the judgment to select models and approaches appropriate to the problem, cost, and latency profile
  • Experience defining evaluation, testing, and observability strategies for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Understanding of AI-specific security and governance concerns, including prompt injection, data leakage, access control on agent tooling, and responsible AI practice
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a force multiplier, balanced with the engineering rigor to know when not to use it

Desirable

  • Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI solutions into production, including tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design
  • Experience building integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
  • Experience introducing AI tooling and practices across an engineering organization, including the change management involved
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, low-formality, high-accountability environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in global or cross-functional organizations is beneficial

Sphera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues.

Overview

A Payment Accuracy, Coordination of Benefits (COB) Specialist, is a member of the greater Coordination of Benefits Business Unit (BU). Coordination of Benefits involves situations in which an individual is covered by two or more health plans. Our specialists are passionate about what they do and are experts at reviewing, discovering, and validating substantial amounts of data and delivering results and insights for our clients.

A Payment Accuracy, COB Specialist, is responsible for reviewing and analyzing claims, member, and group data to identify instances of recoverable claims for the benefit of Cotiviti and our clients. Under direct supervision, this individual will be responsible for establishing the correct order of liability for our clients’ members. This individual will also be responsible for inputting accurate claim recovery information in the proprietary Cotiviti software tools, as well as assisting with related inquiries throughout the claim recovery process.

Responsibilities

  • This individual will work under direct supervision and will be monitored for efficiency in production and quality review of assigned work.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to proactively develop and uphold a solid grasp of Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) guidelines to accurately determine liability order.
  • Leverages cutting-edge Cotiviti audit tools such as the Recovery Management System (RMS), COB Tracker, and client-specific systems to conduct thorough member investigations.
  • Creates detail-oriented, accurate notes in Cotiviti audit tools and/or client tools throughout the member investigation.
  • Meets or exceeds standards of production and quality as identified by compliance and regulatory guidelines and set forth by the Team Lead and/or Manager when reviewing concept and claim identifications for the client.
  • Prepares and evaluates responses to client disputes both internally and externally within the Business Unit as needed.
  • Identify and solve problems by classifying errors and overpayments for our healthcare clients.
  • Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement for efficiencies within reporting and streamlining research processes.
  • Demonstrates understanding of Cotiviti policies & procedures, and external regulatory requirements and performs duties in accordance with such regulatory requirements.
  • Has a basic understanding of the healthcare industry, as well as proven track record of delivering results.
  • Assures confidentiality and security of all data, adhering to all HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability) laws and requirements. Demonstrates the skills, knowledge, and ability to ensure that our environment is safe, complying with industry standards.
  • Has ability to take responsibility for outcome, whether positive or negative and apply learning as applicable.
  • Integrates information from various sources and considers broader context.
  • Tries unique ways of doing things and tests promising ideas.
  • Actively seeks information to understand rationale.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma - Required.
  • Bachelor’s degree (Preferred) and/or a minimum of one (1) year of related experience in healthcare.
  • At least 1-year Cotiviti experience is recommended for individuals seeking their next opportunity internally. (Example: Retrieval Agent and/or Audit Support positions).
  • Healthcare industry experience, including knowledge of Coordination of Benefits (Preferred).
  • Computer proficiency including Microsoft office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • An enthusiasm for working with large datasets and diverse databases will set you up for success in this position.
  • You thrive in both individual and team environments, showcasing self-motivation and determination to achieve success.
  • Understands and embodies Cotiviti's Core Values, Strategic Pillars, and Operations Disciplines to achieve successful performance in completing assigned responsibilities and interactions with the organization, both internally and externally.

Mental Requirements:

  • Ability to analyze large volumes of data, identify trends, discrepancies, and anomalies. Must have exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy in financial records and audit findings.
  • Demonstrates strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex situations, identify key issues, and propose practical solutions. Able to approach challenges methodically and with a strategic mindset.
  • Makes informed decisions based on available data, regulations, and auditing standards. Must be able to weigh options and make recommendations that align with both compliance requirements and organizational goals.
  • Strong understanding of auditing standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Must be able to apply these standards consistently to ensure accurate and compliant audit processes.
  • Ability to recognize when something is wrong or needs further investigation. Must have the initiative to probe deeper into financial records or processes to uncover issues, inconsistencies, or irregularities.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $20.50 to $23.75 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Nonexempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

You will develop sophisticated omnichannel strategies tailored to each client’s unique goals, ensuring measurable success and client satisfaction. This role will be a flex role.     • Analyze cross-channel data and insights to interpret trends and make strategic recommendations, ensuring alignment with clients’ KPIs and the broader commerce media landscape.

  • Product-Led:

    • Integrate Tinuiti’s product and technology suite into channel activations, focusing on scalability, growth, and efficiency, and measuring success through achievement of key client metrics and channel-specific success.

    • Maintain expert-level knowledge of relevant commerce media platforms, proactively educating clients and internal colleagues on updates and benefits.

    • Maintain annual certifications for relevant commerce media platforms applicable to your book of business, ensuring expertise and compliance.

    • Exemplify innovative thought leadership within your vertical/channel and the broader commerce media landscape, advancing agency best practices and contributing insights internally and externally.

    • Collaborate effectively with other channel specialists to share knowledge and best practices, fostering a multi-channel approach to client strategies, tracked by collaboration metrics and knowledge-sharing outcomes.

    • Effectively delegate across commerce team members to execute strategies.

  • Owner Mindset:

    • Proactively assess and diagnose omnichannel opportunities for improvement, implementing changes to achieve growth, retention, and profitability targets, tracked by performance metrics and client outcomes.

    • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by experimenting with new strategies and tools, measured by the implementation of innovative solutions and client feedback.

    • Effectively prioritize and manage time across clients, partner relationships, and internal initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of strategic objectives.

  • Greatness attracts greatness:Seeks feedback, pushes craft excellence, and embraces technology and change.

  • Clients grow, we grow:Prioritizes client outcomes with innovation, precision, and proof.

  • 5-7 years of experience in commerce media, paid commerce, or senior media planning roles with a proven track record of executing successful campaigns with monthly budgets of $500K+.

  • Experience with commerce media platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Criteo, etc. preferred.

About Appriss Retail

Appriss Retail is the total retail loss solution for omnichannel, unifying high-quality data across stores, online, and customer ser-vice to reduce returns, cut shrink, and manage incidents. Our products—Engage to reduce returns, Secure to cut shrink, and Incident to centralize visibility—help retailers move from reactive loss control to strategic profit protection. Together, they empower organizations to make better operations decisions, strengthen accountability, and put hundreds of millions back to the bottom line. Covering 40% of all U.S. transactions and active in 45 countries, Appriss Retail is trusted by 60+ of the top 100 U.S. retailers to deliver lasting performance improvement. Learn more at apprissretail.com.

Overview

The Data Science Manager is a player-coach who leads a small, high-output team while staying deeply hands-on. This role owns the full scope of data science at Appriss Retail — data engineering, governance, and production model delivery — not just model building. The right candidate has built and shipped realdataplatforms andAI/ML systems using a modern stack, has meaningful experience with LLMs and agentic architectures, and canoperatecredibly in both the technical weeds and the business conversation.

This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will write code, review pipelines, define data contracts, and drive architectural decisions — while also growing and directing the team around you.

Essential Duties

Technical leadership & delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact data science projects — from ambiguous businessrequestto production-readysystem.
  • Design andmaintaindata pipelines, data models, and governance standards alongside your team; treat infrastructure as a first-class product concern.
  • Build, evaluate, and iterate on ML models in production; lead experimentation rigor, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Architect and ship LLM-integrated features and agentic workflows — including prompt engineering,tool use, and output evaluation.
  • Guidecloud infrastructurearchitecturefordata scienceprojects, taking into accountperformance,maintenance, and cost criteria.
  • Set the standard for code quality: write production-grade Python and SQL, enforce reviewpractices, andmaintaindocumentation.
  • Partner closely with engineering to integrate models and pipelines into core product infrastructure.

People & team

  • Directly manage 2–4 data scientists; provide technical mentorship, career development, and clear performance expectations.
  • Define team operating norms: sprint planning, code review, documentation, and delivery accountability.
  • Recruit and grow the team as the function scales.

Strategy & stakeholders

  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped analytical and modeling work with defined success criteria.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure data work is grounded in real source systems and product context — not isolated analysis.
  • Contribute to the data and analytics roadmap, balancing near-term delivery with longer-term platform investment.
  • Communicate clearly to non-technical audiences; influence decisions with data and model outputs.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field, orbachelor'swith significant professional experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in data science, data engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 1+yearof direct people management or formal technical lead experience over a team.

Technical skills — required

  • Expert-level SQL and Python; production code, not just analysis scripts.
  • Deep understanding of data infrastructure: pipelines, warehousing, data modeling, and source system behavior.
  • Hands-on ML experience: model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Strong software engineering practices: version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD familiarity.
  • Ability to scope and deliver complex analytical projects independently from vague inputs.
  • Cloud data platform experience: Snowflake, Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiencywith modern data stack tooling:dbt, Airflow, Spark, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated LLM experience: prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, or agent frameworks(LangChain,LlamaIndex, or equivalent)
  • Experience and familiarity with agentic AI architectures: multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and orchestration.
  • Experience in retail, fraud detection, or transaction-level data at scale.
  • Familiarity with ML platform tooling:MLflow, feature stores, model registries, or similar.

Benefits

At Appriss Retail, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at work and beyond. Benefits begin on your first day and include multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, health savings and flexible spending accounts, paid parental leave, and supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments. We offer generous paid time off, a 401(k) with immediate vesting and company match, short- and long-term disability, and free access to health and wellbeing resources such as Calm and Sworkit. You’ll also have access to learning and development opportunities to help you grow your career. Our benefits support your well-being so you can perform your best in every part of life.

Reports to: Director of Data Science

Department: Data Science

Supervisory Duties: Yes

Travel Required: Minimal (optional)

Location/Work Region: Remote - United States

This job is eligible for a 12-15% bonus in addition to the base salary.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, PhD Science, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

  • PhD Science is a hands-on K-5 Science program that sparks curiosity as students build enduring knowledge of how the scientific world works.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced Senior Web Developer who will own our marketing website end-to-end as the sole developer — from architecture and build to day-to-day maintenance and continuous improvement. You'll serve as a technical thought partner to the marketing team, advising on the best way to accomplish goals, not just executing requests. This role requires comfort with one or more CMS platforms (including ideally headless CMS platforms), strong front-end engineering, and enough back-end fluency to diagnose issues, run queries, and keep the technical foundation healthy. You'll build modern, responsive, and secure web experiences while supporting SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — and you'll do it as the primary technical owner, capable of leading the work end-to-end without reliance on a broader development team.


Responsibilities

Front-End Development

  • Build reusable UI components using React, Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap, and Storybook.

  • Create responsive, accessible, and semantic templates that align with brand and UX standards.

  • Implement modern build tools and workflows (Webpack, Vite, etc.).

CMS Development

  • Develop and maintain custom themes, templates, plugins, or content models depending on platform (e.g., WordPress, Contentful, Storyblok, or equivalent).

  • Work with structured content types, custom fields, and content modeling best practices across traditional and headless CMS architectures.

  • Integrate with REST APIs and/or GraphQL for dynamic, decoupled, or headless implementations.

  • Evaluate and implement CMS capabilities that reduce reliance on custom development and empower marketing teams to manage content independently.

Server Fluency & Back-End Support

  • Navigate server environments confidently — read and interpret server logs, identify errors, and escalate or resolve issues independently.

  • Run SQL or equivalent database queries to investigate content or configuration issues, support migrations, and validate data integrity.

  • Manage or support web server configuration (e.g., Nginx, Apache) including redirects, caching rules, and environment-level settings.

  • Work within Linux/Unix command-line environments for routine server-side tasks.

  • Coordinate independently with IT or hosting partners on infrastructure, access, and environment management.

Security & Performance

  • Apply CMS hardening best practices and follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines regardless of platform.

  • Prevent common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection) through secure coding practices.

  • Optimize for Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) using caching, code splitting, and image/CDN optimization.

AEO, SEO & Accessibility

  • Implement clean HTML, heading hierarchy, and crawlable templates.

  • Ensure proper use of meta tags, canonical tags, robots directives, and XML sitemaps.

  • Support structured data/schema markup (schema.org/JSON-LD) for rich snippets and answer engines.

  • Align technical implementation with accessibility, search, and AI discoverability goals.

Collaboration & Workflow

  • Serve as a technical thought partner to marketing, design, and IT stakeholders — advising on feasibility, tradeoffs, and approach, not just executing requests.

  • Use Git-based workflows and contribute in agile/sprint cycles.

  • Document code, architectural decisions, and technical standards to ensure maintainability and scalability.

Requirements

You've spent 5+ years doing hands-on front-end and CMS work — WordPress and/or a headless platform like Contentful — including content modeling, templating, and API-driven content delivery, built with React, TypeScript/JS, Tailwind or Bootstrap, and Storybook, on top of solid PHP and/or , HTML5, and CSS3 fundamentals. You're genuinely comfortable on the server side: reading and interpreting logs, writing and troubleshooting SQL queries, working in a Linux/Unix shell, and doing basic Nginx/Apache configuration — because as the sole developer on this site, there's no one else to hand those problems to. You understand technical SEO/AEO (semantic HTML, structured data, Core Web Vitals) and CMS security (hardening, OWASP) well enough to defend your decisions, and you're comfortable in Git-based, agile workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across both traditional (e.g., WordPress) and headless/API-first CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Storyblok).

  • Next.js, Gatsby, or other headless framework experience.

  • CRM and marketing platform integration experience (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce).

  • Containerized local dev environments (Docker, Lando, DevKinsta, or similar).

  • Cloud hosting experience (Netlify, Vercel, AWS, or similar).

Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or Equivalent

Full-time

Remote

The Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining accurate demand forecasts to support sales, inventory, and customer service objectives. This individual contributor partners cross-functionally translate data, trends, and business inputs into actionable demand plans that drive business performance. The role operates in a professional office or remote environment with frequent virtual meetings and cross-functional collaboration.

What You’ll Bring to Bob’s

At Bob’s Discount Furniture, we value the unique skills and experiences that each candidate brings. Success in this role is driven by a combination of technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, behavioral and leadership skills, and customer focus. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy leveraging your skills to make an impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Skills for Success

To excel in this role, you will need to demonstrate strengths in the following skill areas:

Core Competencies & Expertise

• Demand Forecasting: Develop and maintain top-down and bottom-up demand forecasts across weekly, monthly, and seasonal horizons.
• Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze historical sales, trends, demand drivers, and category, SKU, and regional performance to identify risks and opportunities.
• Reforecasting & Forecast Accuracy: Perform in-season reforecasting, monitor forecast accuracy, and conduct root-cause analysis on forecast variances.
• Inventory & Financial Alignment: Support alignment of demand forecasts with sales, margin, inventory, open-to-buy, and financial targets; identify over/under-bought risks and recommend corrective actions.
• Cross-Functional Planning: Partner with Merchandising, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Inventory, and Finance to gather inputs and communicate forecast updates, risks, and opportunities.
• Product & Assortment Planning: Incorporate product launches and lifecycle changes into forecasts; support assortment planning, product performance analysis, and test strategies.
• Planning Systems & Reporting: Utilize demand planning systems, ERP platforms, Microsoft Excel, and BI tools to generate reporting and actionable insights.
• Process Improvement: Maintain data integrity and support continuous improvement of demand planning and S&OP/demand review processes.

Preferred Competencies & Skills

• Experience in a retail, omnichannel, or consumer goods environment
• Familiarity with S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes
• Experience with Power BI, ERP systems, or demand planning tools
• Strong business acumen and understanding of cross-functional impacts on demand and inventory

Who We Are

At Bob’s, we have fun, we love what we do, and we’re growing fast! As one of the leading omni-channel furniture retailers in the country with over 200 stores, we’re committed to creating a workplace that values skills-based hiring, diverse perspectives, and an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

How We Will Support Your Success

We know you have many choices when it comes to your career. At Bob’s, we invest in your growth, well-being, and career advancement.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick leave, holidays, and your birthday!
  • 401(k) Profit Sharing Plan with a generous company match
  • Pet Insurance and employer-paid Life Insurance options
  • Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement, on-demand learning, and career progression pathways
  • Employee Discount starting on Day 1, plus exclusive partner discounts
  • And so much more!

Our Culture & Core Values

At Bob’s, we believe in fostering a positive, inclusive, and skill-driven work environment. Our core values-Honesty, Integrity, Transparency, Community, Safety, Diversity, Accountability, and Fun—guide everything we do. We’re not just a workplace; we’re a team that supports and celebrates each other!

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, or a related field
• 3–5+ years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, or inventory planning
• Experience working with forecasting tools, data analysis, and reporting
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to analyze large data sets and generate actionable insights
• Strong communication, collaboration, organizational, and prioritization skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
• Detail-oriented approach to planning and analysis

Physical Demands

This is largely a sedentary role. The individual is required to sit for extended periods, use a computer, and communicate effectively. Occasional walking and standing may be required. This is a full-time position; occasional extended hours may be required to meet business needs, and limited travel may be expected.

raw.description:
Join Akvelon — build products used by millions!

Akvelon is an IT company with 20+ years of experience and 1,200+ engineers across 15+ locations worldwide.

We work with both well-known global tech companies, including Microsoft, Facebook, Airbnb, Dropbox, and Pinterest, and with growing startups.

Our teams are involved in different types of engineering projects, from cloud solutions and AI/ML systems to big data, web, and mobile applications.

Since we are remote-first, our engineers work in distributed teams with flexible hours. We value ownership, clear communication, and the ability to take responsibility for your part of the work.



About the project

Our client, a US-based digital health company, is building a closed-loop wellness platform. The central engineering challenge is integration: consolidating around a dozen existing production systems (EMR, wearables, labs, billing, messaging) into a single unified experience, automating data transfers that are manual today, and picking canonical sources of truth per data type — all while handling Protected Health Information (PHI) end to end.

We're looking for a Senior Backend / Integration Engineer to build the API and integration layer that powers the platform, working closely with the architect, mobile, and web teams in a distributed setup.



Requirements

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with strong hands-on TypeScript/Node.js
  • Proven experience designing and building API integrations with third-party systems (REST/webhooks, auth flows, rate limits, retries, data reconciliation)
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL — data modeling, queries, and performance
  • Experience with cloud and serverless environments (Cloudflare Workers/Hono, or Node on AWS/GCP)
  • Solid understanding of building reliable, testable services with automated tests
  • Experience with background jobs, queues, and scheduling
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a remote or distributed team

Nice to have

  • Healthcare / HIPAA experience — building PHI-handling services with audit logging, retention, and vendor BAAs (strong plus)
  • Experience with wearable/health-data aggregators (Terra, Vital) or EMR systems
  • Familiarity with Stripe, managed auth providers (e.g. Clerk), and transactional messaging (email/SMS)
  • Experience integrating LLM/AI features under compliance constraints (BAA-covered inference, logging, guardrails)
  • Experience with a TypeScript monorepo (Turborepo) and shared packages

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the API and integration layer connecting the platform to external source systems
  • Automate data flows that are currently manual, and implement reconciliation across systems
  • Design and implement PostgreSQL schemas and canonical data models per data type
  • Implement PHI controls — audit logging, retention, and data segregation — across services
  • Build background jobs, queues, and scheduled tasks for ingestion and syncing
  • Collaborate with the architect, mobile, and web teams on API contracts and data flows
  • Write automated tests and own the reliability of your services
  • Take ownership of your part of the work and communicate clearly within a distributed team

    • ACE functionality and brokerage software

Experience & Education

Why GHY?
At GHY, we’re committed to building a culture of collaboration, growth, and excellence. You’ll join a team that values expertise, supports professional development, and works together to deliver exceptional service to our clients.

Ready to take the next step in your trade services career?

Apply now and help shape the future of global trade with GHY.

raw.description:
Job Summary

As a Subject Matter Expert – Health System Analyst supporting the VA's Office of Suicide Prevention (TOPR 0037), you will play a critical role in advancing Elevated Risk Care Management initiatives across the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). You will support the analysis, design, development, and implementation of business processes that directly impact the quality and continuity of care for high-risk Veterans. Working within one of the largest integrated federal healthcare systems in the nation, you will collaborate with VHA stakeholders to evaluate current-state operations, identify gaps, and drive sustainable process improvements at both the VISN and Medical Center levels. The ideal candidate is a seasoned healthcare systems professional who thrives in complex, matrixed federal environments and brings a deep operational understanding of VHA clinical and administrative workflows. You are equally comfortable conducting rigorous analytical work independently and engaging senior government stakeholders to communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead the analysis of current and future state VHA business processes related to Elevated Risk Care Management, identifying inefficiencies, systemic gaps, and opportunities for process redesign in support of the Office of Suicide Prevention's mission. Design, develop, and implement improved business processes and workflows across VHA Medical Centers and VISNs, ensuring alignment with VHA policy, clinical standards, and Veteran-centered care objectives. Diagnose operational problems within current VHA care management programs by conducting stakeholder interviews, data reviews, and process mapping, and deliver actionable recommendations to government leadership. Monitor the performance of redesigned and reconstructed business processes post-implementation, developing metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track effectiveness and ensure continuous improvement. Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to VHA program offices, providing guidance on large-scale healthcare system operations, VISN structure, and Medical Center-level clinical and administrative workflows. Prepare and present high-quality analytical deliverables including reports, briefings, process documentation, and recommendations tailored to senior VHA officials and federal contracting stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of experience in health systems analysis, healthcare operations, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated focus on large-scale government or integrated healthcare environments. Master's Degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Health Policy, Business Administration, or a closely related field is required. Extensive, hands-on experience working within or directly supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), including substantive familiarity with VHA Medical Center operations and Veterans Service Network (VISN) structures. Ability to obtain and maintain VA network access and a Position of Public Trust background investigation as required for contractor personnel supporting VA program offices. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship; U.S. citizenship may be required to meet VA background investigation and access requirements. Demonstrated working knowledge of both clinical and business process frameworks within the VHA, including experience supporting process analysis, redesign, or implementation initiatives at the program or enterprise level.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting VA mental health, suicide prevention, or behavioral health programs, particularly within the Office of Suicide Prevention or related VHA program offices. • Familiarity with VHA's Elevated Risk Care Management policies, tools, and clinical workflows, including experience with the Patient Record Flag (PRF) system or the High Risk for Suicide (HRS) care pathway. • Experience applying structured process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Human-Centered Design) within a federal healthcare or VHA context. • Proficiency with VA data systems, electronic health record platforms (particularly VistA/CPRS or Oracle Health/Cerner), and business intelligence tools used within VHA operations. • Prior federal contracting experience in a Subject Matter Expert or senior advisor capacity, with demonstrated ability to deliver high-impact analytical products to GS-14/15 or SES-level government clients.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, PhD Science, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

  • PhD Science is a hands-on K-5 Science program that sparks curiosity as students build enduring knowledge of how the scientific world works.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced Senior Web Developer who will own our marketing website end-to-end as the sole developer — from architecture and build to day-to-day maintenance and continuous improvement. You'll serve as a technical thought partner to the marketing team, advising on the best way to accomplish goals, not just executing requests. This role requires comfort with one or more CMS platforms (including ideally headless CMS platforms), strong front-end engineering, and enough back-end fluency to diagnose issues, run queries, and keep the technical foundation healthy. You'll build modern, responsive, and secure web experiences while supporting SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — and you'll do it as the primary technical owner, capable of leading the work end-to-end without reliance on a broader development team.


Responsibilities

Front-End Development

  • Build reusable UI components using React, Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap, and Storybook.

  • Create responsive, accessible, and semantic templates that align with brand and UX standards.

  • Implement modern build tools and workflows (Webpack, Vite, etc.).

CMS Development

  • Develop and maintain custom themes, templates, plugins, or content models depending on platform (e.g., WordPress, Contentful, Storyblok, or equivalent).

  • Work with structured content types, custom fields, and content modeling best practices across traditional and headless CMS architectures.

  • Integrate with REST APIs and/or GraphQL for dynamic, decoupled, or headless implementations.

  • Evaluate and implement CMS capabilities that reduce reliance on custom development and empower marketing teams to manage content independently.

Server Fluency & Back-End Support

  • Navigate server environments confidently — read and interpret server logs, identify errors, and escalate or resolve issues independently.

  • Run SQL or equivalent database queries to investigate content or configuration issues, support migrations, and validate data integrity.

  • Manage or support web server configuration (e.g., Nginx, Apache) including redirects, caching rules, and environment-level settings.

  • Work within Linux/Unix command-line environments for routine server-side tasks.

  • Coordinate independently with IT or hosting partners on infrastructure, access, and environment management.

Security & Performance

  • Apply CMS hardening best practices and follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines regardless of platform.

  • Prevent common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection) through secure coding practices.

  • Optimize for Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) using caching, code splitting, and image/CDN optimization.

AEO, SEO & Accessibility

  • Implement clean HTML, heading hierarchy, and crawlable templates.

  • Ensure proper use of meta tags, canonical tags, robots directives, and XML sitemaps.

  • Support structured data/schema markup (schema.org/JSON-LD) for rich snippets and answer engines.

  • Align technical implementation with accessibility, search, and AI discoverability goals.

Collaboration & Workflow

  • Serve as a technical thought partner to marketing, design, and IT stakeholders — advising on feasibility, tradeoffs, and approach, not just executing requests.

  • Use Git-based workflows and contribute in agile/sprint cycles.

  • Document code, architectural decisions, and technical standards to ensure maintainability and scalability.

Requirements

You've spent 5+ years doing hands-on front-end and CMS work — WordPress and/or a headless platform like Contentful — including content modeling, templating, and API-driven content delivery, built with React, TypeScript/JS, Tailwind or Bootstrap, and Storybook, on top of solid PHP and/or , HTML5, and CSS3 fundamentals. You're genuinely comfortable on the server side: reading and interpreting logs, writing and troubleshooting SQL queries, working in a Linux/Unix shell, and doing basic Nginx/Apache configuration — because as the sole developer on this site, there's no one else to hand those problems to. You understand technical SEO/AEO (semantic HTML, structured data, Core Web Vitals) and CMS security (hardening, OWASP) well enough to defend your decisions, and you're comfortable in Git-based, agile workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across both traditional (e.g., WordPress) and headless/API-first CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Storyblok).

  • Next.js, Gatsby, or other headless framework experience.

  • CRM and marketing platform integration experience (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce).

  • Containerized local dev environments (Docker, Lando, DevKinsta, or similar).

  • Cloud hosting experience (Netlify, Vercel, AWS, or similar).

Our client, a US-based digital health company, is building a closed-loop wellness platform. Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the API and integration layer connecting the platform to external source systems

Job Summary

As a Subject Matter Expert – Health System Analyst supporting the VA's Office of Suicide Prevention (TOPR 0037), you will play a critical role in advancing Elevated Risk Care Management initiatives across the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). You will support the analysis, design, development, and implementation of business processes that directly impact the quality and continuity of care for high-risk Veterans. Working within one of the largest integrated federal healthcare systems in the nation, you will collaborate with VHA stakeholders to evaluate current-state operations, identify gaps, and drive sustainable process improvements at both the VISN and Medical Center levels. The ideal candidate is a seasoned healthcare systems professional who thrives in complex, matrixed federal environments and brings a deep operational understanding of VHA clinical and administrative workflows. You are equally comfortable conducting rigorous analytical work independently and engaging senior government stakeholders to communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead the analysis of current and future state VHA business processes related to Elevated Risk Care Management, identifying inefficiencies, systemic gaps, and opportunities for process redesign in support of the Office of Suicide Prevention's mission. Design, develop, and implement improved business processes and workflows across VHA Medical Centers and VISNs, ensuring alignment with VHA policy, clinical standards, and Veteran-centered care objectives. Diagnose operational problems within current VHA care management programs by conducting stakeholder interviews, data reviews, and process mapping, and deliver actionable recommendations to government leadership. Monitor the performance of redesigned and reconstructed business processes post-implementation, developing metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track effectiveness and ensure continuous improvement. Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to VHA program offices, providing guidance on large-scale healthcare system operations, VISN structure, and Medical Center-level clinical and administrative workflows. Prepare and present high-quality analytical deliverables including reports, briefings, process documentation, and recommendations tailored to senior VHA officials and federal contracting stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of experience in health systems analysis, healthcare operations, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated focus on large-scale government or integrated healthcare environments. Master's Degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Health Policy, Business Administration, or a closely related field is required. Extensive, hands-on experience working within or directly supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), including substantive familiarity with VHA Medical Center operations and Veterans Service Network (VISN) structures. Ability to obtain and maintain VA network access and a Position of Public Trust background investigation as required for contractor personnel supporting VA program offices. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship; U.S. citizenship may be required to meet VA background investigation and access requirements. Demonstrated working knowledge of both clinical and business process frameworks within the VHA, including experience supporting process analysis, redesign, or implementation initiatives at the program or enterprise level.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting VA mental health, suicide prevention, or behavioral health programs, particularly within the Office of Suicide Prevention or related VHA program offices. • Familiarity with VHA's Elevated Risk Care Management policies, tools, and clinical workflows, including experience with the Patient Record Flag (PRF) system or the High Risk for Suicide (HRS) care pathway. • Experience applying structured process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Human-Centered Design) within a federal healthcare or VHA context. • Proficiency with VA data systems, electronic health record platforms (particularly VistA/CPRS or Oracle Health/Cerner), and business intelligence tools used within VHA operations. • Prior federal contracting experience in a Subject Matter Expert or senior advisor capacity, with demonstrated ability to deliver high-impact analytical products to GS-14/15 or SES-level government clients.

Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day.
